name: Dauntless Juggernaut (Marshal Archetype)
body:
Some marshals become infamous as immortal generals or insurmountable obstacles. Inspiring others by absorbing blows that may kill lesser beings.

Hit Dice: d12

Stoic Bulwark (Ex)

At 1st level, a dauntless juggernaut seems implacable and gains Diehard and Toughness as bonus feats without meeting their prerequisites. In addition the dauntless juggernaut’s aura extends to only 30 feet.

This ability modifies auras.

Steadfast Inspiration (Ex)

At 2nd level, a dauntless juggernaut inspires their allies to stand fast against glancing blows. When the dauntless juggernaut uses inspire action, the dauntless juggernaut and their target both gain +1 bonus to AC and CMB until the beginning of the dauntless juggernaut’s next turn. This bonus increases by +1 for every 5 levels the dauntless juggernaut possesses to a total of +5 at 20th level.

This ability replaces vital inspiration.

Well Trained Obstacle (Ex)

At 3rd level, a dauntless juggernaut has learned how to leverage their training towards more versatile combat and gains one of the following feats a bonus feat without needing to meet its prerequisites: Improved Bull Rush, Improved Dirty Trick, Improved Disarm, Improved Drag, Improved Feint, Improved Grapple, Improved Reposition, Improved Sunder, or Improved Trip. Additionally, a dauntless juggernaut is considered to meet the prerequisites of the chosen feat when selecting feats that require the chosen feat.

This ability replaces Skill Focus.

Tactician (Ex)

A dauntless juggernaut’s tactician ability only applies to allies within 20 feet.

This ability modifies tactician.

Greater Toughness (Ex)

At 8th level and again at 16th level, a dauntless juggernaut gains an additional hit point per class level. This bonus hit point is applied in the same way as the bonus hit points gained from the Toughness feat. Additionally, a dauntless juggernaut may roll twice and take the better result against any effect that would inflict the fatigued, exhausted, nauseated, or sickened conditions as well as against any effect that would reduce their movement speed.

This ability replaces the bonus teamwork feats normally gained at 8th and 16th levels.

Unbreakable Aura (Ex)

At 11th level, merely being present can shift a battle in the dauntless juggernaut’s favor. If rendered unconscious or slain, a dauntless juggernaut’s auras persist for a number of rounds equal to their Constitution modifier.

This ability replaces triple aura.

Expanded Aura (Ex)

At 14th level, a dauntless juggernaut’s aura only expands to a range of 60 feet.

Triple Aura (Ex)

At 19th level, a dauntless juggernaut may now have three auras active at a time.

This ability replaces quadruple aura.
